prerequisite: Historical measurement only: bnxt-prerequisite.patch applied to base_commit; the complete fix is now upstream in PR #653 (ceac6df66e84152a5cd40a31d38909553bd7fabe).
nic: Broadcom Thor2 / bnxt_re_bond, 400 Gb/s per rail
routing: uniform random top-k without replacement, new seed on each validation process
timing: eager HIP events; warmup=20, timed=30, drop_first=1; excludes dtype conversion and expert computation
search: Fixed-reference coordinate search. Initial quick grid: 30 candidates. Joint search adds 80/48/8 and 80/64/8; tokens>=1024 focus on blocks32/64/80 with5warmup/10round screening, otherwise20/30. Complete neutral pair rechecked.
validation: Three fresh two-node process batches, each point once per batch with fresh CCO state; 5 paired reps and ordinary single-live-op A/B; seeds4242/5219/6196.
acceptance: all 3 paired tests win by max(1.5us,2%) with tuner tail guard; every candidate bench beats reference median by same margin; rank-max total p95 <= matched reference p95 * 1.10
limitations: Communication shape microbenchmark, not full DeepSeek inference.
FP8 FNUZ is the MI308 transport representation; V4 native packed UE8M0 scales and FP4 expert weights are not implemented by this experiment.
No automatic interpolation to unmeasured token counts or other NICs/EP sizes.
No host firmware, network QoS, or clock changes. Existing firmware 235.2.40.0 and 50% lossless-TC allocation are documented in mori-check logs.
Uniform routing is not a replay of measured model router traces.
qp_screening: Fixed D/C geometry (80,48,8); 3 interleaved reps, fresh CCO op+communicator per case in persistent Python/gloo workers. New QPs are created per case. 1152 bench cases.
port_counters: Both physical members of all8bonds on bothnodes. ethtool priority5 byte/PFC counters,1.2s settling after each capture and before entering capture from an uncaptured interval; includes correctness+warmup+timing traffic.
jit_preparation: All 1536 requested plans built ahead of measurement with 12 compiler threads; no kernel launched during precompile. Identical content-hash cache copied to peer.
pcie_device_links: Read on both nodes: all 8 GPU and 8 RDMA device links show 32.0 GT/s x16 (PCIe 5.0); this does not characterize switch uplinks.
joint_search_process: Search phases use fresh CCO communicator/op, with persistent Python/gloo workers after the first ~25 points; final acceptance uses three fresh process pairs.
qp_geometry_recheck: 720 additional ordinary benches for tokens>=256 at the tuned geometry, rechecking all four QP counts; filter median p95 <= initially chosen QP p95*1.1, then fewest QPs within 2% of fastest eligible median. Final independent validation follows.
capacity: max_num_inp_token_per_rank equals live input tokens in each case; no larger-capacity/dynamic-live-token performance claim.
validation_process: Three fresh two-node process batches; each of 96 points once per batch in a fresh CCO communicator/op, seeds4242/5219/6196, order reversed/rotated between batches; within each point 5 paired reps and ordinary one-live-op A/B.
